name: Lily
source:
"The fact that I'm a witch... can't be denied."

A witch who has high pride and is always determined to win. However, she also has a timid and vulnerable side. She still thinks of her long lost lover.

[Translated from [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m03/character.html]official website[/url]]
